title: Bihar DPED Result 2026
organization: Bihar School Examination Board / Concerned Training Authority
vacancyDetails: Result of Bihar D.P.Ed. examination for physical education diploma candidates
qualification: Candidates enrolled in D.P.Ed. programme as per Bihar admission / exam rules

selectionProcess: Theory / Practical Examination → Result → Marksheet / Certificate

shortDescription: Bihar DPED Result 2026 is out. Check roll-wise result on the official exam portal.
content:
The Bihar D.P.Ed. (Diploma in Physical Education) Result 2026 has been declared for candidates who appeared in the examination.

Students can check their result using roll number on the official result portal and keep a printout for marksheet / certificate process.

Checklist

  • Verify personal details and marks
  • Download scorecard
  • Contact institute for original documents timeline
